cases.name: Mary Brown
cases.about:
She was a hairstylist. Avis Wainwright said Brown did her hair for years, but was more than just a hair stylist.

"She was like one of my best friends. We went. I've known her for 35 years. We used to go to church with her. And we went to the movies. And she was so good-hearted. And I don't think I'll have another one like her. She didn't have a lot, but she gave a lot. So, yes, it's breaking my heart. And I hadn't felt right since I heard it," said Wainwright.

Linda Tarte said Brown has done her hair for more than two decades.

Tarte can't believe she's gone.

"Mary was my dear friend. I had been with her for having my hair done for 24 years. She was the most loving, special, kind, giving person I know. She was absolutely amazing. The times that I was not able to go in to the shop. She came here and fixed my hair. Just terribly miss her," said Tarte.
cases.narrative: Her body was found off of East Old Marion Highway near Florence.
